atlas-dialog: dialog container; its controls (atlas-* buttons and fields) carry their own ids
atlas-page-*: read-only preview canvas of a packed page (no event handlers)
bone-tree: tree container; rows are operated through tree-bone-* ids
constraint-list: list container; rows are operated through their own ids
curve-panel: panel container; curve controls carry their own ids
curve-segment: read-only label of the selected curve segment
cut-guide-hint: read-only guide note shown when the flat-art guide opens the cut dialog
cutout-dialog: dialog container; its controls carry their own ids
empty-stage: empty-state container; its button is operated through empty-demo
export-dialog: dialog container; its controls carry their own ids
frame-section: panel container; its controls (frame-* fields and buttons) carry their own ids
guide-dialog: dialog container; its controls (guide-* buttons and fields) carry their own ids
guide-progress: read-only progress line, derived from the project
guide-scope: read-only notice that the guide does not act on a project with several original images
guide-step-*: read-only checklist row (data-done); its button carries its own guide-* id
image-derived-*: read-only provenance line of a derived image
image-list: list container; rows are operated through image-* / attach-* ids
imp-anims: list container; its checkboxes are operated through imp-anim-* ids
imp-driven: read-only list of constraints that override imported keys; its opt-in checkboxes carry their own imp-mute-* ids
imp-report: read-only dry-run report of what Import would do
imp-rig: read-only list of rig differences between source and target
import-dialog: dialog container; its controls carry their own ids
inspector: panel container; its fields carry their own ids
key-marquee: drawn selection rectangle (pointer-events: none); the drag lands on the timeline lanes
lottie-dialog: dialog container; its controls carry their own ids
lottie-frame-warning: read-only notice that art is clipped by the project frame
mesh-dialog: dialog container; its controls carry their own ids
mesh-summary: read-only mesh summary in the inspector
mesh-summary-dialog: read-only mesh summary in the dialog
mix-canvas: read-only preview canvas of the transition frame (no event handlers)
mix-dialog: dialog container; its controls carry their own ids
mix-frame-warning: read-only notice that art is clipped by the project frame
mix-time-label: read-only time label of the transition slider
playhead: drawn playhead line (pointer-events: none); scrubbing lands on the timeline lanes and ruler
recovery-banner: banner container; its buttons are recovery-recover / recovery-discard
seq-frame-warning: read-only notice that art is clipped by the project frame
seqd-canvas: read-only preview canvas of the sequence frame (no event handlers)
seqd-describe: read-only one-line description of the step list
seqd-frame-warning: read-only notice that art is clipped by the project frame
seqd-steps: list container; each step's controls carry their own seqd-step-* ids
seqd-summary: read-only summary line (frame count in data-frames)
seqd-time-label: read-only time label of the sequence slider
sequence-dialog: dialog container; its controls carry their own ids
tl-zoom-readout: read-only timeline zoom readout (fit or px/frame)
